# New Origin Consulting Services

> New Origin helps organizations build future-ready workforces through executive search, technical recruitment, recruiter training, and talent-market intelligence.

## Primary website

- [Homepage](https://www.neworigin.in/): Company overview, services, products, jobs, events, news, and contact information.

## Core services

- Executive search and leadership recruitment for C-suite, VP, director, and senior functional roles
- Product and technical hiring for software, mobile, cloud, AI, ML, data, and networking roles
- Non-technical hiring across sales, HR, finance, operations, customer support, and administration
- Recruiter training and certification
- Talent research and market mapping

## Service locations

- Primary location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- India-wide recruitment coverage
- Major metro coverage: Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Chennai
